integrity: The new claim is the full weak distribution, limiting objective-law/expectation constants, and tuning optimum; the sharp order-of-magnitude lower bound is credited to Beretta, Cesari, and Colomboni. Finite computational checks do not prove the limit.
scientific_limitations: Scalar real horizon-tuned nonsmooth objectives, independent bounded Rademacher noise, exact arithmetic, and asymptotic n to infinity. Optimal tuning is within the displayed one-parameter family, not globally minimax. No assertion of an exact finite-n point mass.
title: Soft-thresholded Gaussian last-iterate law for anytime stochastic subgradient descent
